CHANGE IN TIMING OF CONFERENCE CALL OF MANAGING DIRECTOR AND CEO OF THE
BANK 
    
Dear Sir’s,  
 
In continuation to our intimation bearing reference no. JKB/BS/F3652/2026/161 dated 14th 
October, 2026 communicating schedule of conference call of Mr. Amitava Chatterjee, Managing 
Director and CEO with the analysts and investors, please be informed that the conference call shall 
now be held at 1530 hours (IST) instead of earlier communicated time of 1600 hours (IST). 
 
The other details regarding the conference call shall remain unchanged.  
 
This is for your information and appropriate dissemination. 
 
Yours faithfully  
   
   For Jammu and Kashmir Bank Limited
